scenes.q: Retinol: when do you use it?

scenes.text: At night. Sunlight breaks retinol down, and it can make your skin more sensitive to the sun. Wear sunscreen the next morning.

Retinol: morning or night? 🌙
Night. Sunlight breaks retinol down, and retinol can make skin more sensitive to the sun. Use it at night, then sunscreen every morning.
